synopsis.p: Returns reference to the used byte reader.

synopsis.prototype: template<class... Args> explicit reader(Args&&... args) C++11
synopsis.p: Forwards all parameters to the used byte reader.

Tries to extract the next code point from byte sequence using ByteSReader. On success utf8::status::ok is returned and the code point is stored in cp. utf8::status::eof is returned when no more bytes available. Other values are returned on errors, see for more details. ByteSReader::operator() is used to access individual bytes.
synopsis.note: The function itself doesn't throw exceptions but exception can be thrown by ByteSReader::operator().

synopsis.p: Same as parse() but returns true on success, false on EOF or throws an exception from otherwise.
Creates UTF-8 reader using specified ByteSReader.
